correctness.rationale: The shortest-border decomposition is a bijection because each chosen nonoverlapping unbordered border excludes all shorter borders. Exact product-sum tails converge to geometric tails; an absolutely summable coefficient argument removes even widths, and uniform geometric majorization justifies expected-value convergence. The finite matrix rank-one update is unit lower triangular, yielding an exact formal identity; the composition/array correspondence follows by a reversible last-part split and all boundary conditions. The package verifier confirms 84,133 exhaustively enumerated words, 116,901 direct all-border greedy-optimality checks, power-series coefficients through degree 75, rows through 80 and published expectation values. All infinite steps are proved, not inferred from finite checks.
